statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56847 is a Node.js Permission Model bypass: under --permission, trace_events.createTracing().enable() starts the trace agent, which writes trace log files to the --trace-event-file-pattern path, without checking that --allow-fs-write covers that path. Node.js fixed it for 22.x in 22.23.2, the 2026-07-29 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases; release notes https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.23.2), and its CVE record lists 22.x as affected through 22.23.1. The 22.x fix is commit 0566c3cccd, 'permission: enforce fs write permission for trace events' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/0566c3cccd), which carries this CVE id: NodeCategorySet::Enable now resolves the trace file path with a new NodeTraceWriter::GetFilePath() function and throws unless file-system write permission covers it; Node.js 22.23.1 has neither the check nor that function. We read usr/bin/node, the only file each package installs, in every nodejs-22 package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-28, on x86_64 and aarch64: 13 builds from 22.22.0-r0 to the current 22.23.5-r0, each checked against its repository index checksum. 22.22.0-r0 through 22.23.1-r0 (22.22.0-r0, 22.22.1-r0, 22.22.2-r0, 22.22.2-r1, 22.22.3-r0, 22.23.0-r0 and 22.23.1-r0) report Node.js v22.22.0 through v22.23.1; 22.23.2-r0 is the first that reports v22.23.2, and 22.23.3-r0 through 22.23.5-r0 report v22.23.3 through v22.23.5. The binary's dynamic symbol table exports node::tracing::NodeTraceWriter::GetFilePath in 22.23.2-r0 and every later build, and in none of the builds before it.

CVE-2026-56847 is a Node.js Permission Model bypass: under --permission, trace_events.createTracing().enable() starts the trace agent, which writes trace log files to the --trace-event-file-pattern path, without checking that --allow-fs-write covers that path. Node.js fixed it for 22.x in 22.23.2, the 2026-07-29 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases; release notes https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.23.2), and its CVE record lists 22.x as affected through 22.23.1. The 22.x fix is commit 0566c3cccd, 'permission: enforce fs write permission for trace events' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/0566c3cccd), which carries this CVE id: NodeCategorySet::Enable now resolves the trace file path with a new NodeTraceWriter::GetFilePath() function and throws unless file-system write permission covers it; Node.js 22.23.1 has neither the check nor that function.
